scope: Actual SDK and host with scripted loopback replies; direct macOS launcher without outer isolation. No external model calls.
finding: A funded original 15-second child survives the three-second hold without a follow-up. An independent two-second foreground follow-up completes, but its retained global timer aborts the still-valid old child before its own deadline. Descendant call ownership does not fix selective timeout cancellation.
next_work: Cancel only the expiring grant and its owned descendants, requests and jobs while preserving explicit workspace-wide user cancellation; separately resolve root automatic wakeup ownership.
replay: Copy the three mjs files together to a fresh directory two levels below the repository root, then run probe.mjs --funded and probe.mjs --funded --followup. Do not copy these nested scripts in place and expect relative imports to resolve.
